Several shallow steps are visible at the foot between flared white curbs; the passage has patterned paving, lanterns and a gate visible beyond. Dark louvred shutters and a barrel-tile canopy sit above the arch. This is a separate access from the Cervantes ramp and the big-pool steps.

note: Dave, 2026-10-21. The lane runs down continuously from the restaurant's west end to the paseo between the house gardens and a long white wall on the pool-lawn side; the wall's lawn face gets lower towards the sea. Calle Jorge joins part-way down with no visible steps. The single-storey white kiosk at the foot stands at lawn and paseo level; the lane passes west of it to the beach gate and zebra crossing. Heights are not measurable from the mesh.
